title: Sokoto Caliphate founded
summary: Islamic scholar Usman dan Fodio led a jihad that created a large state in what is now northern Nigeria.

notes.problem: Place: source says Sokoto city was founded by Muhammed Bello in 1809; in 1804 dan Fodio's base was Gudu. 'Sokoto' did not exist at the 1804 founding.
